description: This file defines classes related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator classes for null, carriage return, and line feed, as well as a template class for stream text handling with customizable terminators. It appears to be part of a core library for handling text streams with specific termination sequences.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for managing text streams with customizable terminators, including nested handler class for data transmission and reception.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Checks if a character indicates termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the string marker for the terminator sequence.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if the stream is idle.
